name: Red Light Therapy Face Mask
description: The Hooga Red Light Therapy Face Mask is a flexible silicone LED mask designed for daily at-home skincare. It uses 66 tri-chip LEDs across three wavelengths — 630nm, 660nm, and 850nm — for a full-face session in as little as 5 minutes, hands-free. Choose the Face Mask Only , add the optional Neck Piece for décolleté coverage, or grab the Face + Neck combo . Both connect to the same rechargeable controller — no wall outlet, no dangling cable during your session. Why Customers Choose the Hooga Face Mask Three real wavelengths, not one — 630nm + 660nm red plus 850nm near-infrared, all delivered from every LED via tri-chip construction. Cordless during use — 3,000 mAh battery (mask only) or 5,000 mAh (face + neck set) built into the controller. Multiple sessions per charge. Fits comfortably — flexible medical-grade silicone with adjustable back strap. Adjustable everything — brightness (25% / 50% / 75% / 100%), timer (5 / 10 / 15 / 20 min), and Nogier pulse frequency (73 / 146 / 292 Hz) or continuous mode. Under a pound — 0.39 lbs face only, 0.79 lbs with the neck piece — sits comfortably during long sessions. Specifications Model: HG-MSK-03 Wavelengths: 630nm, 660nm (red) + 850nm (near infrared) LEDs: 66 tri-chip on the face mask, 48 tri-chip on the neck piece Surface irradiance: 50 mW/cm² Beam angle: 120° Pulse frequencies: 73 / 146 / 292 Hz (or continuous) Timer: 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 minute auto-shutoff Rated power: 5W (face only) / 8W (face + neck) Battery: 3,000 mAh (face only) / 5,000 mAh (face + neck) Charging: USB Type-C, 5V DC input Weight: 0.39 lbs (face only) / 0.79 lbs (face + neck) Warranty: 1 year Simple 6-Step Setup Cleanse — remove makeup and any cosmetics that could reflect or block light. Strap — feed the facial straps through the inlet holes and secure the velcro at the back of your head. Fit — position the mask with the LEDs facing your skin, align the eye/nose/lip cutouts, and adjust for comfort. Power on — press and hold the controller's power button for 3 seconds. Choose your session — pick your timer, brightness, and (optionally) a pulse frequency. Relax — the timer auto-stops the session. What's in the Box 1 × Hooga LED Face Mask (Face Only or Face + Neck depending on variant) 1 × Rechargeable controller (with built-in battery) 1 × USB Type-C charging / connection cable 1 × Carrying bag 2 × Silicone eye guards 1 × User manual Download the Hooga Face Mask instruction sheet (PDF) Backed by a 1-year warranty and easy 60-day returns. This device is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Consult a healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, taking photosensitizing medications, or have a skin or medical condition. Not sure which product is right? Give a Hooga gift card.
